justification: Image A depicts a rich array of schematic engraved figures (anthropomorphic figures with raised arms, circle/disc motifs, animal forms, boat-like shapes, dotted trails) arranged across a rock surface, while Image B shows an eroded architectural or geological surface with faint vertical carved niches or figure-like shapes but no clear iconographic figures comparable to A.
